scope_summary: One generated twin2mc-* service account in the selected existing GCP project, one project custom-role binding, and one user-managed JSON key; request-scoped bootstrap and API-enable authority is not retained.
rationale: The Phase 8 PoC persists GCP deployment CloudConnections as service-account JSON credentials. The Deployer authenticates that account, inspects its project role binding, and checks the fixed API baseline; this binding makes that executable boundary explicit without granting project creation, billing mutation, API enablement, or custom-role administration to the retained identity.
limitations: The binding is restricted to an existing billing-enabled project in europe-west1 and does not claim organization or project-creation support.
A user-managed service-account key is a bounded PoC trade-off; organization policy can prohibit its creation and the setup must then fail closed.
Project-level testIamPermissions covers only the project-testable subset; resource-scoped provider operations still require the supervised preflight and deploy/destroy gates.
The fixed Phase 8 API baseline remains enabled after identity cleanup and is not owned by the retained deployment account.
